BEYOND THE CURRENT PROTOTYPE

01

From visual difference to shared understanding

Test the writing system with readers from different language backgrounds. Explore

what helps them recognise, learn and interpret unfamiliar signs.

02

From instant response to delayed correspondence

Introduce waiting, interruption and reply into the interaction. Investigate how a delayed

message can still carry care, memory and a sense of presence.

03

From authored alphabet to collective language

Invite participants to contribute signs and meanings. Explore how local variations might

emerge while a shared reference keeps communication possible.

CURRENT LIMIT / A speculative visual-writing prototype; it does not demonstrate the evolution of a natural language.

What changes when we leave Earth—

and what do we carry home?

Different worlds. An ongoing conversation.
